feeds.title: Healthy By Heather Brown
feeds.description: Do terms like mental health, love languages, and buzzy wellness words make you feel overwhelmed? Do you feel torn when people tell you to 'slow down and enjoy the moments,' when your moments are running together faster and faster, and you're surviving on coffee and mom guilt? Don't know where to start in your personal journey to thriving? I got you, friend! I'm here to come alongside you and give you doable steps to become the healthiest and most confident version of yourself- without getting swept up in hustle and comparison traps...

feeds.title: She Gave It A Go Blog
feeds.description: Follow along with Brendt Blanks as she writes about all things Faith, Family & Farmhouse in her home influencer style blog. She Gave It A Go is a Top AL Home & Lifestyle blog created by Brendt Blanks that explores 3 themes; faith, family, and farmhouse.

feeds.title: Simply Elliott
feeds.description: Simply Elliott focuses on living simply through real recipes, creative projects, family life, fashion, and faith. Finding joy in balance & simplicity!

feeds.title: The Southern Source
feeds.description: Food and cocktail recipes for the modern Southern woman. Get entertaining tips, travel guides to Southern cities, and tools to look and feel your best. My name is Meredith and I am a true southern girl sharing my love for cooking, cocktails, and the southern lifestyle.

feeds.title: A Byers Guide
feeds.description: A Byers Guide is an Alabama based blog that specializes in affordable fashion, home decor, travel, and lifestyle. I am Courtney Byers. I created my blog as a hobby to fulfill my need to have a creative outlet in my life when my husband, Jake was in medical school.

feeds.title: Blossom and Become
feeds.description: I'm Sarah. My husband, Kurt, and I live in Birmingham, AL with our three little ones. This is where I'll be sharing recent reads, favorite recipes and products, everyday style, details about our travels, etc.

feeds.title: Grasping for Objectivity
feeds.description: I am Rachel Callahan, a 35-year-old Mom of two kids in Birmingham, Alabama. I write about entertaining things, and about real stuff which may be helpful once in a blue moon.

feeds.title: Thyme with Laura
feeds.description: Your resource for healthy and wholesome recipes, wellness tips for a healthier life, everyday hacks that really work, and the Best of Birmingham's restaurants and boutiques. Plus, Laura shares some sage advice for the everyday woman on life, family, food and beauty.

feeds.title: Carlyle Thornton Blog
feeds.description: Carlyle Thornton is a fashion + lifestyle blogger born & raised in Birmingham, Alabama. She created this blog in the fall of 2017 as a creative outlet to share with you all things that inspire her. Her goal is to help others cut a few corners and to simply make life easier by sharing the latest trends, great products, home decor inspo, travel guides, life-hacks & more!

feeds.title: Lindz Lutz Blog
feeds.description: A blog by Lindsey Lutz is created for the fashion-obsessed, globe-trottin', bad-ass woman (or man) looking for a little creative inspiration.
